title: Hide WooCommerce marketplace suggestions
description: Answers WooCommerce's own woocommerce_allow_marketplace_suggestions and woocommerce_helper_suppress_admin_notices filters, which turn off the panels offering paid extensions on the products, orders and settings screens. Notices about your store itself — a pending database update, a gateway that needs configuring — are untouched.
breaks: Extension recommendations no longer appear on the products, orders and settings screens
